name: East Rithwic Outpost
title: East Rithwic Outpost
summary: One of the old starter outposts, destroyed by Martine in The First Strike; Hydeatha the Shopkeeper and Mindorla remain with cows and chickens. In the kit: the Life Stone on open lawn (z 24) beside a golden plinth, a 28 m ruined Empyrean monument tower with a tapered roof and four green lamps (top z 51.9), and two cottages with a rabbit hutch to the south. Not the ruin filmed in rithwic.05 (that is the Destroyed Portal to Greenspire, 470 m north-west).

shots.standingOrder: Rise 7 m from just above the grass behind the outpost's sparkling Life Stone until the ruined Empyrean monument tower stands clear in the warm afternoon light; keep 3 m from the stone and the golden plinth.
